title: Case-Only AuthorNameRaw Policy Decision & Human-Review Integration
builds_on: Phase 4X (final decision C, HUMAN_REVIEW_PATH_IS_REQUIRED) and its addendum's 5 answered questions

option_1_auto_match.false_positive_risk: low but nonzero -- no real collision found in this dataset, narrow theoretical locale edge cases untested
option_1_auto_match.claude_md_compatible: debatable -- first automatic name-based decision inside merge-safety path itself
option_1_auto_match.authorreviewqueue_consistency: weak -- that precedent is confidence-gated automation WITH a human fallback, AUTO_MATCH has no fallback
option_1_auto_match.journal_id_decision_consistency: weak -- that function never auto-resolves CONFLICT even for narrower cases
option_1_auto_match.auditability: weaker than an explicit human confirmation
option_1_auto_match.reversibility: same manual recovery path as any executed merge, not reversible automatically
option_1_auto_match.operational_complexity: requires new, unbuilt executor-level bypass mechanism (see task_h)

option_2_human_review_only.journal_id_decision_consistency: strong -- same never-auto-resolve posture plus a label
option_2_human_review_only.auditability: strong -- every case-only merge still goes through the same explicit human step as any other conflict
option_2_human_review_only.operational_complexity: none beyond the labeling implemented this phase

task_a_policy_comparison.conclusion: Option 1 is weakest on 4 independent axes and requires unbuilt infrastructure to have any practical effect; Option 3 discards real, deterministic, tested information; Option 2 captures the classifier's value with none of Option 1's costs

task_b_reasoning: no evidence rose to 'strongly proves A is preferable'; repository's consistent design posture (AuthorReviewQueue threshold+fallback, journal_id_decision's CONFLICT refusal, NO_AUTO_COPY_FIELDS, build_author_conflict_report's own no-formatting-preference docstring) treats human decision as default even where pure logic might support automation

task_c_exact_rule.none_handling: None on either side -> (False, explicit reason)
task_c_exact_rule.character_count_guard: len(a) != len(b) -> (False, ...) before any lower() call

task_d_human_review_integration.authorreviewqueue_reuse_reasoning: keyed on (PaperID,UserID) co-author-linkage decisions, a different table/decision shape than a merge-time conflict report; the plan's own existing conflict-list structure (same pattern field_actions/child_table_actions/journal_state already use) is the closer, simpler reuse target

task_e_reason: selected policy is B, not A -- Task E's AUTO_MATCH gating requirements are not triggered

required_cases_covered.case: missing value vs non-missing -> NOT case-only
Al-Amin vs Al Amin -> NOT case-only
D'Angelo vs D Angelo -> NOT case-only
no unintended impact on JournalID conflict logic
no unintended impact on AuthorNameRaw conflict behavior outside case-only category
